decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks build directly on the firm's dental lab and custom-manufacturing knowledge, and the dedicated page from launch shows the firm can interpret demand and improve the line.
PETG thermoforming blanks are closely related to existing thermoforming and dental material capabilities, giving the firm strong absorptive capacity to learn from market feedback.
UV-curing lacquer is adjacent to the firm's materials and digital workflow know-how but had only a website mention, leaving more uncertainty about early results and a moderate withdrawal risk.
Custom earmolds draw on existing custom-device manufacturing and hearing-care channels, allowing the firm to apply accumulated knowledge to improve the product line.
Custom hearing protection earmolds build on related earmold and hearing-care capabilities, and the firm's in-house R&D can assimilate feedback to keep the line viable.
